podcast.title: Hectic School, Band Struggles
podcast.body: During the 1999-2003 period, John found things "hectic and crazy" while trying to finish school, noting that the band was barely existing after seven or eight years, questioning its future. "For me, it was things were just so hectic and crazy trying to finish school and the band barely existing and same feeling like seven or eight years into it, like what's happening."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

podcast.title: Humber College (Music then Business)
podcast.body: In 1996, John attended Humber College for a year, studying music, before switching to a business program and working various part-time jobs to make ends meet. "John, at that point, I think I was at in Humber in 96 for music. I only did that for a year and then I ended up switching over and taking a business program through school and then working, you know, trying to make ends meet that way of where I worked just like part-time jobs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

podcast.title: Pre-Band Jobs
podcast.body: Before the band found success, John worked at a car auction, and then later at Chrysler in 1996. "Well, I would have been working at a car auction at this time and then Chrysler would have happened shortly after that. Like, you had 96."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

podcast.title: Temporary Departure
podcast.body: During a dark period for the band, after Aaron Solowaniak's MS diagnosis, John Gallant left the band for a few months, contributing to the feeling that the band was "not happening anymore." "It was a really dark time. And then John had left the band for a few months."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Departure of Future Billy Talent Members
xref.body: Ben Kowalewicz, John Gallant, and Aaron Solowaniak decided to leave To Each His Own because they wanted to pursue a heavier and different style of music than what the band was doing. "And then the three of us decided to leave that band. Which was called what? To each his own. And we decided to go, we wanted to do some heavier kind of stuff and some different kind of things."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Billy Talent In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: No Lineup Changes
xref.body: Since its formation in 1993, the core lineup of Ben Kowalewicz, Ian D'Sa, John Gallant, and Aaron Solowaniak has remained constant, aside from some temporary situations. "Never. No. Never. That's insane. Yeah. There's been some temporary things here and there, but this has been the band."
